messages:
Ravi P: Seeing a novel pattern after the routing-rollout: SSE streams emit a payload, then ~9-11s of silence, then resume. No reconnects. Customers notice UI spinner.
Jo S: Can you share a sanitized trace? curious if pings were dropped or if chunks are simply delayed.
Ravi P: paste sanitized trace:
GET /v1/stream?model=redwood-serve
: 200 OK
data: {"delta":"start"}
... <10s silence> ...
data: {"delta":"cont"}
Jo S: Silence ~10s aligns with probe TTL. We shipped a keepalive-suppression flag to reduce tiny egress — maybe it's suppressing probe frames during sticky handoffs.
Olga M: That would make console show session as open but no recent output -> UX mismatch. Console only shows open sockets, not last-output-time. We should add a session "last activity" column (last SSE/event/ping).
Ravi P: Also worried about billing: if SDKs retry on perceived stall, we could get duplicate jobs. Are token-billing events tied to socket or actual token stream?
Jo S: Billing triggers on token events, not socket state. But client-side retries can re-run actions. Short-term mitigation: push an SDK debounce to ignore reconnect <200ms during rollouts and add header x-graceful-restart when draining.
Olga M: Action items: 1) revert keepalive-suppression on canary region (eu-west-2) to confirm. 2) infra to emit a verbose ping telemetry for 1% of sessions so we can distinguish probe suppression vs real stall. 3) console: add "last activity" metric and a dashboard tile for "silent-pause rate" by region and route.
infra-bot: Rollback requested by Ravi P: revert/keepalive-suppression -> canary eu-west-2. Smoke tests queued. :white_check_mark:
Jo S: Longer term: add a "soft-priority" metric on the throttler so we know when sessions are deprioritized without a 429. That explains throughput dips with no quota alerts.
Olga M: Agree. Also surface example traces in the console tile (sampled) so PMs can click into raw byte timings.
Ravi P: I'll monitor post-rollback traces and upload a few to the sample pipeline. Report back in ~15m. Thanks :thumbsup:
